query: I'm designing "KEP-5593: Configure the max CrashLoopBackOff delay" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "On Success and the 10 minute recovery threshold". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, both the **`Success` case** and the **10-minute recovery threshold** were considered in the design documents (`keps/sig-node/5593-configure-the-max-crashloopbackoff-delay/README.md` and `keps/sig-node/4603-tune-crashloopbackoff/README.md`):

### 1. The `Success` Case
* **Prior Consideration:** Per the **Drawbacks** section (which references canonical tracking issue [Kubernetes#57291](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/57291) and related issue [Kubernetes#50375](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/50375)), an early version of the KEP addressed constant or instant backoff for `Succeeded` pods.
* **Why it was dropped/not adopted in the current scope:** The scope was narrowed to address only early recovery. Even though `Success` handling had high user interest, early recovery was chosen because it is more approachable and easily modelable, and establishing benchmarking and insights there will help address late recovery and other cases in future enhancements.

### 2. The 10-Minute Recovery Threshold
* **Prior Consideration:** Under the **Refactor of recovery threshold** section, the proposal analyzed whether modifying the maximum backoff delay should also modify the backoff counter reset threshold (which was calculated based on $2\times\text{max backoff}$, or $2\times 5\text{ minutes} = 10\text{ minutes}$).
* **Why changing/removing it was not adopted:**
  * While the document notes there is no particular end-user value in artificially preserving the arbitrary 10-minute threshold, **late recovery is an explicit non-goal** of this KEP.
  * To reduce the number of changed variables during the alpha period, the proposal chose to maintain the 10-minute recovery threshold by refactoring [`client_go.Backoff.hasExpired`](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/util/flowcontrol/backoff.go#L178) to compare against a flat rate of 300 seconds (or separate it from standard `client_go.Backoff` behavior) rather than changing the recovery threshold timing at this stage.
